description:
A Spring Boot-based engine for generating fixed asset schedules
		and calculating depreciation using methods like Straight Line, Double Declining Balance,
		and Declining Balance.
		Built with Spring Boot 1.1.12.RELEASE, it leverages a robust dependency ecosystem,
		including Spring Web for RESTful services, Lombok for streamlined code,
		and Jackson for Java 8 time support,
		all managed through Maven properties for consistent versioning.
		Designed for Java 8 compatibility, it provides a reliable solution for
		fixed asset management in enterprise applications.
